robotsRules.title: robots.txt rules
robotsRules.description: Your rules; the lines that keep pages out (below) are added to each group, and the Sitemap lines come from the sitemaps below.

blockSearchPages.title: Keep search results out
blockSearchPages.description: Adds Disallow lines for addresses with a search parameter of Searches and 404s (q, s, search and query unless you set yours there), so search engines do not crawl endless result pages.

blockParameters.title: Sort and filter parameters to keep out
blockParameters.description: Query parameters of your sorted and filtered lists, comma-separated, as your storefront names them; a name ending in * covers every parameter that starts with it (attr.* covers attr.color). Adds Disallow lines for addresses that carry one. Never list a parameter of pages you want in search results, such as page numbers or a landing page's brand and grade. At most 20.

blockPaths.title: Private pages to keep out
blockPaths.description: Paths of pages made for one visitor, such as the cart, checkout and account pages, as your storefront names them: each one, the pages under it and its query strings get Disallow lines (/cart keeps out /cart, /cart/… and /cart?…, never /cartoons). / and a path holding your sitemap are never kept out. At most 20.

blockAiCrawlers.title: Block AI training crawlers
blockAiCrawlers.description: Adds a group that keeps crawlers which only collect AI training data (GPTBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, ClaudeBot and others) off the whole site. Search engines and AI answer bots that cite your pages still follow your rules.

sitemaps.title: Sitemaps
sitemaps.description: https addresses of your sitemaps on this website. Empty: https://<your domain>/sitemap.xml, where Ecommerce's sitemap route serves it.

googleVerification.title: Google Search Console verification
googleVerification.description: The content of the google-site-verification meta tag (or the whole tag).

bingVerification.title: Bing Webmaster Tools verification
bingVerification.description: The content of the msvalidate.01 meta tag (or the whole tag).

metaVerification.title: Meta domain verification
metaVerification.description: The content of the facebook-domain-verification meta tag (or the whole tag).

yandexVerification.title: Yandex Webmaster verification
yandexVerification.description: The content of the yandex-verification meta tag (or the whole tag).
